definitions.explanation: In mathematics, the sum of the terms of a sequence ({数列|すうれつ}), such as 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + …. A school and university mathematics term.

examples.japanese: {無限級数|むげんきゅうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{和|わ}。
examples.english: The sum of an infinite series.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{級数|きゅうすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{収束|しゅうそく}する→収束する：26807_shuusokusuru⟧。
{等比級数|とうひきゅうすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{公比|こうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絶対値|ぜったいち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧1⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{収束|しゅうそく}する→収束する：26807_shuusokusuru⟧。
examples.english: A geometric series converges when the absolute value of the common ratio is less than 1.

notes:
⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧ (rank, step) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number). A technical term from mathematics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無限級数|むげんきゅうすう}: infinite series
- {等比級数|とうひきゅうすう}: geometric series
- {級数|きゅうすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収束|しゅうそく}する→収束する：26807_shuusokusuru⟧ / ⟦{発散|はっさん}→発散：09132_hassan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a series converges / diverges

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{数列|すうれつ}→数列：26001_suuretsu⟧: sequence, the list of terms, while {級数|きゅうすう} is their sum

WATCH OUT:
- {級数的|きゅうすうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ means "to increase exponentially", short for {等比級数的|とうひきゅうすうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
